answer: An agent network resists Sybil attacks through radiometric attestation, binding identities to in-situ thermal proofs from an ember source on an assigned ridge. Nodes confirm uniqueness by correlating radiant decay with spectral signatures from native willow scrub. Attackers incur severe capital costs deploying physical sensory devices per identity rather than spawning virtual processes. However, ambient wind gusts distort thermal gradients, periodically failing honest nodes.
